market.question: WTI Crude Oil (WTI) closes above $93 on May 11?

May 11 is the next trading day; closing >$93 requires no more than ~2% drop. WTI daily vol ~2-3% so a single-day move below $93 is plausible but not the base case. Tail risks: an Iran ceasefire announcement or OPEC+ supply news.
